title: Duxo's Simple Player Heads
description: Allows you to get any Minecraft Player's Head!
body:
Allows any Player to get any head from their Username!

Do 
```
/trigger duxo.givehead
```
to open the menu below, put in the username of your choice and how many heads you want!

![Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b78227426fcc27351d2a35294fc5698c123a8f1b.png)
